name: Sophie Freedman
bio: Hi! My name is Sophie Freedman and I am a senior at Barrington High School. I am President of the Barrington chapter and I have been involved in FBLA for several years. As Social Media Chair for Rhode Island FBLA, I hope to share all of the opportunities offered by FBLA through fun and engaging content. My goal is to provide more resources through our social media and website for members to expand their involvement and find ways to grow as a member!
